description: Block until a request whose URL contains url_filter completes, then return it. Event driven, so there is no polling. Call this immediately AFTER triggering the action, or pass a filter that has not fired yet — a request that already completed is returned straight away. Gives up after timeout_ms and tells you so.

allow_existing.description: Satisfy immediately from an already-completed matching request.

url_filter.description: Substring the request URL must contain.

name: network_wait_for_request
